Aliza G.: Heads up — prepping a SERP playbook + live webinar landing + three launch posts. Need a short SEO ops plan: keyword targets, schema for the webinar page, internal-link anchors from blog/docs, and redirect mapping for older webinar pages. Who can take lead?
Matt (Growth): I can own redirects + canonical mapping. Quick question — are we keeping /webinars/2024/* or migrating to /resources/webinars/*? Need a redirect matrix to proceed.
Sam SEO: I recommend consolidating under /resources/webinars/ — fewer thin pages and better crawl equity. Core KW clusters I see: "llm inference cost", "model serving latency", "inference deployment options". I'll drop a CSV with priority buckets.
Sam SEO: Basic JSON-LD we should add to the landing head: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Building cost-efficient LLM apps","startDate":"2025-05-12T10:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.inference/webinar/llm-costs"}}
```
Jonah PM: @Sam SEO that's helpful. For messaging iteration, can we A/B the H1: "Cut inference costs 3x" vs "Predictable LLM latency at scale" — which maps to which KW cluster?
Sam SEO: First maps to the cost cluster; second to latency. Suggest the canonical H1 favor the primary KW we want to rank for, and use the subhead to capture the other cluster.
Laura Ops: I can run an internal-linking sweep — create ~10 contextual links from docs + blog -> webinar landing. Any preferred anchor text? We should avoid exact-match spammy anchors.
Aliza G.: Prefer natural anchors like "inference cost strategies", "Redwood inference deployment guide", and "reducing LLM latency". Mix exact and branded where appropriate.
Matt (Growth): Redirect plan: old /events/llm-costs -> /resources/webinars/llm-costs with 301s, update sitemap, then submit to GSC. I'll draft a mapping matrix and share later today. :thumbsup:
Sam SEO: Also recommend adding FAQ schema + running structured-data tests in staging. Example FAQ seeds: "How much does inference cost?", "Which deployment is private?" — I'll author 4 Q/A pairs.
Aliza G.: Action items: Sam — KW CSV + 4 FAQ Qs (EOD). Matt — redirect matrix + sitemap update (due tomorrow). Laura — linking sweep (start tomorrow). Jonah — coordinate headline A/B on the webinar page. We'll have a 15-min sync at 15:00 to confirm.
